title: Keep the registry level with the disk
why: Once a setup passes a handful of units, the written list and the directory drift in both directions: units nobody documented, and documented units that were deleted. An agent reading the list then reasons about a setup that does not exist, and the mismatch is invisible until something is dispatched to a name that is gone.
fix: List every agent and command in one place, and check both directions rather than only that the doc names real files. A generated table beats a hand-kept one because it cannot drift.
